## Note on this list

This is the single consolidated reference list for the thesis, compiled by extracting every
entry from the seven chapter reference sections, de-duplicating across chapters, and sorting
alphabetically. The chapter tags in square brackets record where each work is cited, and are
retained during drafting so that any entry can be traced back to its use; they are removed in
the submission version. Entries carrying a verification flag are those whose full source has
not yet been retrieved directly; each is flagged in the chapter text at the point of use.

Style: APA 7th edition. Where a work is a preprint, a patent, an industry commentary, or a
government deliverable rather than a peer-reviewed publication, this is stated in the entry,
so that the weight a reader should place on it is visible from the reference list alone.

---
